newsitem.title: USA: Antennas America Q1 income up/EPS flat.
newsitem.headline: Antennas America Q1 income up/EPS flat.

text.p: Antennas America Inc said Friday that income for the first quarter of 1997 increased 99 percent to $33,939 compared to $17,019 for the same period in 1996.
The company reported no increase or decrease in earnings per share for the quarter, flat with the first quarter of 1996.
Revenues increased to $615,376 from $517,406 for the same period, the company said.
As a result of increased sales, the company said gross profit for the first quarter increased 32 percent as compared to the same period last year.
The company said gross profit margin increased 6 percent for the same period last year with Selling, General and Administrative expenses increasing 27 percent.

The company said the increase in SG&A expenses is primarily due to the increased marketing, advertising and personnel expenses associated with the introduction of the company's Freedom and Walldo off-air antenna systems.
